abstract: Evaluates commercial terms, contractual liability limits, and contracted bunker purchase commitments
system_message:
You are Commercial procurement lead (CPL). The Commercial procurement lead (CPL) evaluates commercial terms, contractual liability limits, and contracted bunker purchase commitments for candidate marine fuel supplier consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Vendor credit monitoring（CRED）
information_points.content:
CPL-CRED-G8E：Vendor credit monitoring records indicate that Nordic Bunkering & Logistics Group has an approved commercial credit line tenor of 30 d under its commercial trading facility as specified in its commercial banking facility letter.
CPL-CRED-I5J：Vendor credit monitoring records show that the commercial banking facility letter for Zeeland Marine Fuels Consortium establishes a commercial credit line tenor of 60 d under its commercial trading facility.
CPL-CRED-7A3：Based on the commercial banking facility letter, Channel Maritime Energy Alliance holds a commercial credit line tenor of 90 d on its commercial trading facility.

information_points.title: Evaluates commercial terms, contractual liability limits, and contracted bunker purchase commitments（PROC）
information_points.content:
CPL-PROC-2IF：According to the concession agreement risk review, Channel Maritime Energy Alliance does not hold an approved contractual liability ceiling under standard maritime casualty and indemnification terms, while its nominal contracted bunkering volume is listed at 15000 t in the annual commercial off-take schedule.
CPL-PROC-SGV：For Zeeland Marine Fuels Consortium, the concession agreement risk review confirms an approved contractual liability ceiling under standard maritime casualty and indemnification terms, and the annual commercial off-take schedule reflects a nominal contracted bunkering volume of 12000 t.
CPL-PROC-1AN：Nordic Bunkering & Logistics Group maintains an approved contractual liability ceiling under standard maritime casualty and indemnification terms according to the concession agreement risk review, with a nominal contracted bunkering volume of 18000 t scheduled in the annual commercial off-take schedule.
